title: Are influencers out of touch? Their followers are starting to think so
subhed: Like many content creators, French YouTuber Léna Situations has faced harsh criticism that she seems out of touch. title: The forgotten French prisoner of 9/11
subhed: Zacarias Moussaoui, who was sent to the US by Al-Qaeda to prepare attacks and was convicted of complicity in the September 11 attacks, has spent the past 20 years serving a life sentence without the possibility of parole in a high-security penitentiary in Colorado. His lawyer is requesting his transfer to France.

title: Céline Dion's Paris residency brings economic boost: 'When you're a fan, money is no object'
subhed: After six years away from the stage, the Québécois superstar begins a run of 26 concerts in Paris on Saturday. Hoteliers, restaurateurs and retailers hope to benefit from the influx of nearly 800,000 fans, both French and international. The windfall is estimated at between €500 million and €1 billion, but it comes at a climate cost.
